schemeScope: Combined Paper 1 and Paper 2 scheme. PDF 1–2 cover and note; 3 listening tariffs and the section-level language deduction; 4–6 listening transcript (never shown to students); 7–11 listening answers, ending in the cover-mark table; 12–16 composition marking, Stíl/Ábhar bands, Cumas Gaeilge criteria and 80-mark table, and the short / off-title reductions; 42 modified marking (SMM). PDF 17–41 are Paper 2; 43–44 blank.
reviewMethod: Every paper page and every applicable scheme page read in the text layer and checked against the printed page; each listening prompt, scheme slice and composition line is asserted against the PDFs by the builder.

audio.note: The SEC archive serves one 2020 recording (LC001ZLP017IV.mp3, HTTP 200 on 2026-11-04, 45,899,115 bytes); the scheme transcript (PDF 4) heads it “An Triail Chluastuisceana Ardleibhéal/Gnáthleibhéal”, so one recording serves the Higher and Ordinary 2020 listening test. No other year’s recording is used.

nonPoolDecisions: Listening: “Luaigh dhá …/Tabhair dhá …/Scríobh síos dhá …” asks for two points at 2 + 2; the scheme lists more accepted points than required. These are answer keys for one task, not task routes.

Card unit for listening: one card per printed segment (Fógra, Mír, Píosa), as the reviewed 2021–2025 components, because the Bank plays one recording section as one exercise; every printed question is a separate criterion at its published 2 or 2 + 2 tariff (23 questions, 60 marks).
Composition: A–C is a closed choose-one; each of the nine printed titles is its own whole 100-mark card. AISTE nó ALT (form) and the debate stance (ar son nó ina aghaidh) stay inside one response.
The modified marking scheme changes assessment for eligible candidates, not the printed tasks.
sourceFindings: Paper 1 = 160: Cuid I listening 60 (Cuid A 18 = Fógra 1 10 + Fógra 2 8; Cuid B 28 = Comhrá 1 14 (Mír 1 8 + Mír 2 6) + Comhrá 2 14 (Mír 1 8 + Mír 2 6); Cuid C 14 = Píosa 1 6 + Píosa 2 8), every question 2 marks or 2 + 2; Cuid II composition 100 (choose one of A, B, C).

Layout: 2020 prints no answer booklet. The cover (PDF 1) carries the instructions; Cuid A is on paper page 2, B on 3–4, C on 5; the composition Treoracha are on page 6 and the choice, length note and titles on page 7; page 8 is blank.

Listening language: “Bainfear ó 0 go 3 ar chaighdeán na Gaeilge” is printed only on scheme PDF 3; it is one section-level deduction, stated in each card note without being applied. The listening answer key ends at “Léirigh na marcanna mar seo ar chlúdach na Cluastuisceana:”; 2020 prints no annotation-symbol table.

Composition: 2020 prints no S1–S4 grades; scheme PDF 16 prints the reductions for a short or partly off-title attempt (Stíl 4/3/2, Ábhar 13/11/9, Gaeilge 68/56/44), lifted beside the Stíl criterion. The marking text on PDF 12 is cut before the printed score boxes (“Stíl (5) = …”).
Paper page 7 prints the A, B and C box headings with a SymbolMT dash (U+F02D); it sits only in the raw selection-decision line, never in a card.
